# Yiheng Wang

> Personal website of Yiheng Wang, project and operations manager, looking for a role as a project manager or operations manager. She was project manager for the RiskMandate team at Web Summit Lisbon 2026, one of the three editors of PrompTugal.news, and ran one of the largest teams of AI agents there without a technical background. Every fact on this site names its public source and the date it was read.

This file is for AI agents and the people using them. Pick the instructions that match who you are acting for, read them in full, then follow them.

## Who are you acting for?

- [A hiring manager or recruiter](https://yiheng-wang.agenticcells.site/agents/hiring.md): you want to know whether Yiheng fits a role, and to ask the site questions. Read-only.
- [Yiheng Wang herself](https://yiheng-wang.agenticcells.site/agents/yiheng.md): you are one of Yiheng's own agents and she wants to change her site.
- [A site editor](https://yiheng-wang.agenticcells.site/agents/editor.md): you act for someone Yiheng has agreed may edit the site (for example Dinis Cruz), adding materials or improving pages.

If you cannot tell which, use the hiring manager's instructions: they change nothing.
